hero.title: Personal support, corporate analytics and validation in one system
hero.subtitle: The current product already combines self-check flows, company management, aggregated analytics and a prediction-to-outcome loop. This page maps those modules into three service formats.
hero.note: All charts below are illustrative examples based on existing product capabilities, not live customer data.

blueprint.title: Three service tracks of one platform
blueprint.subtitle: The platform works as a personal service for users, an analytics service for companies, and a validation service for programs and research. Below is how its role changes across these three scenarios.

personalFlow.title: Personal support track
personalFlow.description: For individuals, the service combines daily observations, exercises and tailored recommendations into one coherent action path.
personalFlow.focus: Focus: continuous personal support, short feedback loops and visible progress.

corporateFlow.title: Corporate operations track
corporateFlow.description: For companies, the service combines roles, groups, team analytics and risk signals into one manageable operating model.
corporateFlow.focus: Focus: aggregated team visibility, scoped access and timely management action.

researchFlow.title: Research validation track
researchFlow.description: For foundations and programs, the service connects cohorts, outcome measurement and evidence accumulation to validate hypotheses.
researchFlow.focus: Focus: impact validation, repeatable observations and accountable program reporting.

b2c.title: For individuals
b2c.description: The personal layer combines mood tracking, questionnaires, diary notes, exercises and progress history into one continuous mental well-being journey.

tracking.title: Track state
tracking.description: The mood tracker, notes and evidence-based questionnaires create one timeline instead of scattered check-ins.

support.title: Act immediately
support.description: Breathing, meditations, calming exercises, affirmations and tips turn insight into the next practical step.

consistency.title: Stay engaged
consistency.description: Saved content, progress pages and mental games help users return to routines that actually improve their state.

outcomes.one: A clear view of how state changes over days and weeks.
outcomes.two: Actionable practices connected to real product modules, not abstract advice.
outcomes.three: A measurable feedback loop between self-checks, interventions and progress.

b2b.title: For companies
b2b.description: The corporate layer adds company roles, group hierarchies, invites, access scopes, mood analytics and decision support for managers.

governance.title: Structure the organization
governance.description: Companies, groups and manager scopes can be configured so each role sees only the teams and metrics it is responsible for.

analytics.title: Monitor teams
analytics.description: The dashboard aggregates mood, stress, energy and focus across groups, time ranges and filters without manual consolidation.

decisionSupport.title: Act on risk
decisionSupport.description: Decision support surfaces risk events, evidence and financial impact so leaders can respond before issues escalate.

outcomes.one: A shared view of employee well-being without exposing raw personal timelines.
outcomes.two: Team-level trends for mood, stress, energy and focus in one analytics layer.
outcomes.three: Operational decisions backed by analytics, access scopes and evidence.

rd.title: For research programs and foundations
rd.description: The research layer uses questionnaires, cohorts, evidence accumulation and outcome tracking to validate interventions at program level.

cohorts.title: Build comparable cohorts
cohorts.description: Standardized self-checks and behavioral signals make it possible to compare participants with similar patterns.

validation.title: Validate predictions
validation.description: The prediction-to-outcome loop shows where forecasts were correct, where drift appeared and what improved after intervention.

reporting.title: Report impact
reporting.description: Aggregated evidence and trend views support foundations and research programs that need transparent progress stories instead of one-off snapshots.

outcomes.one: A population-level view built from the same modules people use every day.
outcomes.two: An accumulating evidence base that confirms or refutes each program hypothesis.
outcomes.three: A path from intervention delivery to accountable outcome reporting.
